name: Coloplast A/S
summary: Coloplast A/S develops and sells intimate healthcare products and services in Denmark, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Chronic Care, Voice & Respiratory Care, Interventional Urology, Advanced Wound Dressings, and Biologics. It provides ostomy care products, including SenSura Mio, which provides fit individual body shapes and discretion for various types of ostomies; and SenSura Ostomy care solutions, as well as ostomy accessories under the Brava brand.
